issues.description: The problem statement requires Bookstore to have an initializer init(books: [Book]) (problem_statement.md lines 9-12). In the solution implementation the initializer is declared as init() and then attempts to assign self.books = books (which refers to a non-existent parameter), causing a constructor signature mismatch and a compile error. This contradicts the specified constructor signature and will prevent students from building a correct Bookstore instance as described.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bookstore initializer match the problem specification by changing the implementation to init(books: [Book]) { self.books = books }. Ensure the template and solution both expose the same initializer signature so students implement and call Bookstore(books: ...) as required.
